dct_description_sm: The objectives of this project are: 1) to collect a set of baseline data for contaminants in Arctic seawater against which future trends, sources and sinks in the ocean may be evaluated; 2) to collect the data in a way that will assist physical modeling of exchanges between water and the bottom of the foodweb, and; 3) to apply the ocean contaminant data to the design of a practical monitoring strategy for Canadian Arctic waters.
